newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexican daily port, shipping update for Feb. 7.
newsitem.headline: Mexican daily port, shipping update for Feb. 7.

text.p: All major Mexican ports were reported open Friday as a new cold front approached the northern Gulf of Mexico, the Communications and Transport Ministry said in its 1000 local/1600 GMT daily report.
The ministry updated port conditions and shipping warnings for the Gulf of Mexico, Caribbean and Pacific Coast.
Slightly cloudy with possible rains. Winds reported at up to 10 to 15 knots (19 to 28 km/11 to 17 miles per hour) with waves from three to five feet high.

New cold front lowering temperatures in north and northwest with winds from the north and northwest of 10 to 20 knots (19 to 38 km/11 to 22 miles per hour). On Saturday, winds are expected at the same intensity and growing stronger.
Possible rains on coast of north Veracruz and Yucatan peninsula. Winds of 15 to 20 knots (28 to 38 km/17 to 22 miles per hour) in the region and waves four to six feet high.
Hot with few clouds, moderate winds from the north and southeast at 20 to 30 km.
